preconditions.description: The number of gnomes N must be between 1 and 500.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**9 for k in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each query's time k must be between 0 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N for x in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each query's gnome id x must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= g[i][j] <= 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the friendship matrix g must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(len(receivers)) + '\n' + (' '.join(map(str, sorted(receivers))) if receivers else '-1')
postconditions.description: The output must correctly count and list the gnomes who know the joke after k minutes.
The list of gnomes who know the joke must contain unique ids.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= receiver <= N for receiver in receivers)
postconditions.description: All listed gnomes must have valid ids within the range of 1 to N.
